notes: Replace names/lines with local-model output; keep ids stable unless you also change the projection.

reeve.name: Reeve
lines: A production ledger has vanished from the hall.
Start at the logging camp. The last timber tally was entered yesterday, then the book disappeared.

woodcutter.name: Woodcutter
lines: I carried the timber tally to the mill myself.
The miller was arguing with someone from the mine. Ask there next.
locked_lines: If the reeve wants me, the reeve can say so.

miller.name: Miller
lines: The miner did not take the ledger from me.
But he knew it was missing before anyone announced it. That is what bothered me.
locked_lines: I am working. Come back when you have a reason to interrupt me.

miner.name: Miner
lines: All right. I found the ledger on the ore road.
I hid it because the figures prove somebody has been shaving every shipment. Read it before you decide who the thief is.
locked_lines: I have nothing to tell you.

healer.name: Healer
lines: The sawmill sends splinters, the forge sends burns, and the mine sends everything else.

storekeeper.name: Storekeeper
lines: Wood, grain and ore all pass through the village. That makes the ledgers almost as important as the goods.

farmer.name: Farmer
lines: Mind the crop rows. There is a track for a reason.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
lines: Good ore can still make bad iron. Most mistakes happen between the mine and the hammer.

distiller.name: Distiller
lines: Everyone remembers the grain that becomes bread. They remember this grain the morning after.
